responsibility: Defines the V850 backend’s machine constraints used by reload, register allocation, and instruction recognition in the .md patterns. It classifies legal register subsets and immediates such as 5-bit, 16-bit, movhi-compatible, and displacement forms, and also identifies target-specific memory and symbol forms for the EP/ZDA/SDA/TDA small-data models and special symbolic addresses, so that V850 instruction alternatives in v850.md can select encodable operands and addressing modes.
